scope: vLLM V1 cache interface and current Prefix Caching / Paged Attention design documents.

claims.claim: The KV store path writes newly computed K/V into cache slots specified by slot_mapping.
claims.locator: Store kernel docstring and slot_mapping argument
claims.notes: Exact address calculation and tensor layout are backend/model specific.

claims.claim: Paged attention uses block mappings and backend metadata to access non-contiguous KV blocks.
claims.notes: Backend support and physical layout are version- and platform-dependent.

claims.claim: V1 prefix caching uses block hashes, reference counts, a block pool, a free queue and eviction of reusable blocks.
claims.locator: Data Structure, Block Allocation, Free, Eviction
claims.notes: Do not reduce this implementation to a generic copy-on-write pointer model.

claims.claim: Completed KV blocks are hashed using block tokens and preceding prefix context for cache reuse.
claims.notes: Multimodal content and cache isolation can add extra hash inputs.
